work_item: B05 ordinary CLI explicit evidence-ledger classification and declared-inference links with English admission correction
subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine
purpose: Caller-supplied source/claim/inference ledger -> sealed input -> unique Core -> scoped metadata classification with original source maps and typed stops -> actual report projection/Pointer consumers
three_document_set: N/A; no construction three-document set specified
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

baseline_defect.observed: The same strict two-source ledger reached COMMIT/COMPUTED in Japanese, but lowercase and mixed-case English stopped with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE, UNKNOWN and no dependency. All original requests and complete saved results were checked by separate inspect.
baseline_defect.cause: The coarse document-admission guard compared an 18-byte prefix with the 19-byte ASCII command evidence-synthesize, so English requests never reached the existing case-insensitive complete header parser.

correction: Use the command literal length in the case-insensitive admission prefix check, removing the incorrect magic length; advance parser revision to v35. Full-header validation and ledger algorithms/report schema are unchanged. Unsupported suffixes still suspend.

tests_and_route.route_method: Real minidora-rust --json processes and fresh stores; actual report dependencies read using actor/case-authorized Store::get_bytes; separate inspect matches original request/body and complete result. Actual report bytes become explicit projection and Pointer inputs.
tests_and_route.post_review: Reverse the second inference premise order to differ from lexical order, including the raw escaped ID token. The two affected fixture/pipeline tests are rerun successfully (5 stores/11 requests), with workspace fmt/check/clippy. Product source, input test and the other two CLI tests are unchanged.
tests_and_route.full_workspace_tests: NOT_RUN; one input and four focused normal-route tests plus affected fixture/pipeline reruns, with workspace all-target compile/lint. No full B05 or R2 acceptance claim.

fixtures.purpose: Authored source/claim labels for metadata classification; no assertion that any synthetic claim is a true external-world statement.

route_observations.route: Main ledger through Japanese, lowercase and mixed-case English
route_observations.source_maps: All 41 exposed source spans are checked exactly: 8 source-ID/group maps + 26 citation text/stance maps + 7 inference ID/text/premise maps. Ranges/digests come from independent unique fixture containers/raw tokens. Decoded-equal raw/escaped text, claim IDs and group labels are included. Claim-ID maps and output offsets are not provided by the synthesis report and are not claimed.
route_observations.ordering: Sources/citations retain input order; claims have exact ID lexical order. Inference IDs and final premise order differ from lexical sorting, so source/caller order is explicitly tested.
route_observations.inference_boundary: Both declared inferences remain USER_DECLARED_INFERENCE_NOT_VALIDATED, including a chain referencing a contradiction and refuting agreement. No support, truth or entailment is propagated.

route_observations.route: Exact supplied independence labels and explicit claim identity
route_observations.evidence: Same-group repetitions count one group. Trailing space, case and precomposed/decomposed Unicode differences remain distinct labels. Same-group opposite stances still contradict; same-group refutations repeat. Identical text under different explicit claim IDs stays separate SINGLE_SOURCE records. These exact-label counts do not establish real source independence.

route_observations.route: Actual report -> ordered declared_inferences/claims projection -> raw classification Pointers
route_observations.evidence: Both language variants use actual report text, selected raw root-field/source-output maps and actual projected JSON as the next input. Pointer results retain CONTRADICTION and USER_DECLARED_INFERENCE_NOT_VALIDATED. This is caller-fed composition, not an inferred Core plan or validated logical derivation.

Every case is SUSPEND/UNKNOWN with no result dependency and durable original request/complete result. Cases include ID collisions, label conflict, invalid stance, source-only premise references, self/forward/duplicate premises, empty lists and unknown fields. A cycle is rejected by the ordered forward-reference constraint; no general cycle/entailment solver is claimed.

render_and_persistence_evidence: Positive synthesis cases check COMMIT/COMPUTED, RENDERED, actual text hash, content-plan equality, one authorized dependency equal to displayed report, source document digest and full original request/body/result via separate inspect. COMPUTED describes the ledger-classification result, not claim truth.
versioned_recomputation_boundary: Three explicit input-ID/version-1 retries preserve original Japanese success and English stops. Explicit version 2 reaches COMMIT for all three while retaining originals in prior_results. All recomputed report text and dependency digests equal the original Japanese result, confirming language admission rather than a changed classification algorithm.
traceability_update: B05 retains the existing concrete entry route and removes its leading UNMAPPED placeholder in the actual-entry field; baseline source lineage remains UNMAPPED. Only B05 runtime evidence/gap text and test results change; requirement/disposition/acceptance and 93-record population are preserved.

known_limits: These authored examples are scoped QC, not an independent held-out B05 acceptance population.

Source identities, independence labels, texts, stances and links are caller-supplied. The route does not fetch/extract documents, verify source identity or independence, prove claim truth or validate inference entailment.
UNKNOWN stances and general natural-language evidence synthesis are not supplied by this ledger grammar.

Full resource-boundary matrices, full workspace runtime regression, external LIVE, Windows/macOS, physical 8 GB QA, release and deployment are NOT_RUN. B04 residual populations remain unverified and are not closed by this B05 follow-up.

acceptance.B05: UNVERIFIED; selected explicit-ledger normal routes and one admission correction observed, not complete multi-document evidence synthesis
